title: StickerPanel::open, GifPanel::open and EmojiPanel::open bools sit beside tab and list stages and gate upkeep work (sync_shown_media)
trigger: panel opened from the composer, the manager and demos each set `open = true` by hand; close() resets it by hand
effect: no bug traced today; an owner going away without calling close() would keep thumbnail/shown-media upkeep running while hidden
fix: one PanelStage enum (Closed/Open{tab}) owned by the composer window slot, with close on window/chat teardown

title: ConnectDriver keeps outgoing_typing and outgoing_voice as two Options for one 'my chat action' stage
trigger: typing in the composer then starting a voice/video-note recording (or the reverse): sync_record_action cancels typing by hand, sync_outgoing_typing does not cancel voice
effect: no bug traced; the two slots must be exclusive by hand-kept convention, and a cancel send that fails after take() leaves the server showing the old action until it times out
fix: one OutgoingAction enum { None, Typing(..), Recording{kind,..} } so a new action replaces and cancels the old one in one transition

title: Seed { Unseeded, Seeded } is the old bool in disguise (From<bool>/Into<bool>) beside PresetsSeed, the real stage of the same 'seeded' fact
trigger: DataStoragePrefs::storage_limits_seeded is flipped by note_storage_limits_seeded after a set_storage_limits send, not on the server's answer
effect: no bug traced; a storage-limit write that failed server-side still marks the limits seeded and is never retried
fix: fold into one enum with the presets seed or drop it and derive from storage_limits.chosen(), set on the answer

title: EarnPage::stars_tab bool is a second selector beside EarnPage::screen (Monetization/Stars) for which currency tab shows
trigger: Monetization page: the UI flips page.stars_tab by hand (ui/earn/revenue.rs:451); EarnScreen::Stars ignores it
effect: no bug traced; two fields pick the shown tab and only the UI keeps them consistent
fix: fold the tab into EarnScreen (Monetization{tab: Ton|Stars}) so one value names what is shown

title: A JoinBox lives in two homes: EarnState::join_box or parked inside Recipients::Loading{join}; opened/parked by choose_recipient bool
trigger: Join an affiliate program that needs a recipient: open_or_park_join parks the box while recipients load; the UI calls recipients.drop_parked() from three places on close
effect: no bug traced; a Loading->Failed/Ready transition that does not hand the parked box back, or a close path that forgets drop_parked, leaves the box parked or lost
fix: one JoinFlow enum { None, WaitingForRecipients(JoinBox), Open(JoinBox) } owned by EarnState; recipients answer moves WaitingForRecipients to Open in one transition

title: AccountProgress::stage is an Option used as a 'started' flag: None means 'Initializing', Some(..) the real stage
trigger: AccountExport::start publishes AccountProgress::starting() (stage None) until the worker's first step() call
effect: no bug traced; every reader (label, detail, fraction, is_settled) must treat None as a stage of its own
fix: add AccountStage::Starting and make stage a plain AccountStage (AccountProgress becomes a newtype or goes away)
